decision_rule_applied: At least one item not_met (dementia documented in the chart, NEU-X5 / FORM-X1), so deny. 15 pending items are also listed.
patient_summary: 74-year-old single woman, currently homeless (Z59.00), referred for major depressive disorder. The face sheet and MAR read like a skilled-nursing facility stay ('Resident', LOS 36), though the referral says hospital admit. Diagnoses: thoracolumbar disc degeneration (primary), MDD, unspecified dementia, unspecified psychosis, anxiety, insomnia, protein-calorie malnutrition, generalized weakness, unsteadiness on feet, ASHD. Medications: risperidone 1 mg BID, mirtazapine 7.5 mg qHS, escitalopram, PRN lorazepam, temazepam, ondansetron, acetaminophen, milk of magnesia. Vitals stable and afebrile on room air. PT: walks 300 ft ×2 independently without a device, transfers independently, needs max encouragement, psych precautions. Missing: H&P, AOx exam, SI screen, MRSA and COVID swabs, psychiatric stability statement. Both referral forms say no cognitive impairment, but the chart lists dementia.

not_met_reasons: Dementia (F03.90) is documented in the chart on the face sheet (p10) and MAR (p11). The admission criteria list dementia as ineligible (NEU-X5) and the referral form excludes cognitive impairment (FORM-X1). Both referral forms leave 'cognitive impairment' unchecked, but that is the referrer's attestation and the chart outweighs it.
